title: Basin-lake family-care migrant outlet-passage choreography
scope: Qualitative outlet-passage movement and care choreography for the family-care migrant governed by WLD-ECOLOGY-006 and WLD-ECOLOGY-009. Exact outlet geography, route capacity, hydraulics, internal physiology, performance, survival, Mana use, taxonomy, and human knowledge remain open.
approval_evidence: After three complete visual passage-choreography cards were displayed and chat confirmation was required, the Author replied 'A' on 2026-08-14, selecting 'A — Margin-Ratchet Procession'.
question: What qualitative outlet-passage choreography should govern the family-care migrant without pre-empting the physical geography and passability of the outlet?
selection: Use A — MARGIN-RATCHET PROCESSION. Where suitable support is available, paddle-columns brace in successive groups while a travelling margin wave drives a short advance, and the vault settles low between surges. The observable rhythm is settle → ripple → brace → surge → settle. Before advances, the caregiving form normally attempts to regroup mobile young beneath the refuge. During autumn descent, the same structures brake and steer current-assisted slides. The behaviour requires a compatible bed-or-margin contact and resting-opportunity chain but does not establish that one exists or that the outlet is passable. The card's warning that passage may be slow and conspicuous, and that abrasion, paddle-column injury, fatigue, crowding, or a broken chain of resting opportunities may stop it, is retained as a qualitative feasibility concern rather than a fixed performance, event, or rate claim.
alternatives: A — MARGIN-RATCHET PROCESSION: successive paddle-column bracing plus short margin-wave advances, low pauses, pre-advance regrouping, and current-assisted autumn braking and steering; selected.
B — THREE-LOBE EDDY SLALOM: oblique deeper-water movement and rotation between lower-current recovery pockets, with young shifting to the lee; not selected.
C — VAULT-CHAIN LEAPFROG: temporary groups alternate holding and advancing while young transfer between overlapping refuges or protected wakes; not selected.
rationale: The selected package makes difficult movement, care, exposure, fatigue, and failure directly visible while using only the structures accepted by WLD-ECOLOGY-009. It extends the accepted paddle-column and travelling-margin-wave foundation with a bounded mechanical relationship, but keeps route support and actual passability as a separate geography problem rather than assuming an accommodating outlet or a cost-free Mana solution.
evidence: Author selection on 2026-08-14: after all three complete visual option cards were displayed, the Author replied 'A'.
consequences: Where suitable support is available, successive groups of paddle-columns brace while a travelling margin wave drives a short advance; the vault settles low between surges, producing the observable rhythm settle → ripple → brace → surge → settle.

This closes a bounded part of the formerly open relationship between the paddle-columns and margin wave during demanding passage, but exact anatomy, actuation, ordering, force, pressure cycle, contact, stroke, timing, efficiency, and the rest of the locomotor repertoire remain open.
During autumn descent the same structures brake and steer current-assisted slides, without establishing a current profile, channel, passive-drift strategy, exact speed, or successful control outcome.

Before advances, the caregiving form normally attempts to regroup mobile young beneath the refuge; regrouping is fallible and creates no perfect communication, compulsory juvenile response, guaranteed return, shared brood, or multiple-carer structure.

The card's warning that passage may be slow and conspicuous, and that abrasion, paddle-column injury, fatigue, crowding, or a broken chain of resting opportunities may stop it, is a qualitative feasibility concern rather than a fixed performance, event, or rate claim.

A compatible bed-or-margin contact and resting-opportunity chain is a route requirement, not an accepted physical feature. No outlet profile, depth, substrate, hydraulics, seasonal level, salinity transition, route capacity, or passability is established.

Tracks, disturbed feeding trails, predator ambushes, and exposed transitions remain conditional implications whose occurrence depends on local substrate, ecology, and geography; they are not guaranteed events, mapped locations, or automatic character knowledge.

Margin-Ratchet Procession is an author-facing editorial label, not an in-world name, formal ethological category, organised convoy, fixed line formation, social cooperation rule, shared brood, or multiple-carer structure.

WLD-ECOLOGY-006 continues to govern migration timing, juvenile diet, competition, predation and harvest, escorted departure, mortality, recruitment, and population variability; WLD-ECOLOGY-009 continues to govern the foundational body plan and mobile refuge, and this decision uses only those accepted structures without adding anatomy.

Finite matter or material and usable-energy inputs, internal transport, heat and waste handling, maintenance, injury, disease, recovery, repair, reproduction, route capacity, mortality, and carrying capacity remain causal; no activated ability, free Mana, pooled identity, shared progression, Skill, class, reward, spawn, reset, refill, or guaranteed recovery is created.
residual_unknowns: Exact paddle-column group size, order, actuation, load sharing, contact, stroke, pressure cycle, steering, stability, fatigue, repair, and failure remain open.
Exact margin-wave origin, timing, amplitude, frequency, direction, control, energetic cost, and contribution outside this choreography remain open.
Body posture, buoyancy, depth use, advance distance, speed, endurance, pause duration, recovery, and spring-ascent versus autumn-descent differences remain open.
Actual outlet bed, margins, resting pockets, substrate, hydraulics, seasonal water levels, route capacity, hazards, tidal reach, salinity transition, and passability remain open.
Regrouping cues, communication, distances, timing, juvenile capacity, crowding, displacement, predation risk, and failure response remain open.
Respiration, circulation, osmoregulation, senses, feeding, waste handling, disease, reproduction, adult diet, and juvenile physiology remain open.
Family or travelling-group size, carer number and sex, kinship, formation, interaction among families, mortality, recruitment, and population scale remain open.
Mana pathway, abilities, progression, appraisal, cognition, sapience, human knowledge, and protagonist knowledge remain open.
reopening_conditions: Later outlet geography or hydrodynamic modelling cannot provide any viable version of the compatible support and resting-opportunity chain required by the selected behaviour.
Later anatomy, physiology, energy, care-capacity, or migration modelling cannot support the selected rhythm and fallible regrouping pattern.
Later accepted ecology or story canon creates a concrete contradiction.
The Author explicitly requests a different outlet-passage choreography.
